meta.name: mode-creator
meta.description: Interactively create, install, activate, and verify custom claude-mem modes, including domain-specific observation types, concept tags, optional Telegram alerts, bot setup, worker restart, and startup-context verification. Use this whenever someone asks to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, track domain-specific notes, add observation types or tags, or send Telegram notifications for particular memories—even if they do not use the word "mode."

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自定义 AI 该记住哪些内容,按领域打标签并推送提醒
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让 AI 按自己的领域习惯记住要点并在关键记忆上收到提醒
copy.tagline_en: Customize what your assistant remembers, tag notes by domain, and fire alerts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your assistant to remember domain notes and alert you on key ones.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先问你在做什么,据此提一套笔记分类(观察类型和概念标签),经你确认后安装并启用该模式、重启 worker,再验证新模式出现在启动上下文里。
howto.when: 当你想自定义 claude-mem 记住什么、新建或修改模式,或为特定记忆设置 Telegram 提醒时触发。

say.text: 帮我建一个模式,专门记录设计决策、客户偏好这类笔记
say.note: Claude 会先问你在做什么,再提分类方案给你确认

say.text: 我想给现有模式加上 Telegram 提醒
say.note: 会让你选触发用的观察类型或概念标签

say.text: 帮我确认新模式装好了没,启动上下文里有吗
say.note: 会重启 worker 并检查启动上下文

howto.what_en: Claude interviews you about your work, proposes observation types and concept tags, then installs and activates the approved claude-mem mode, restarts the worker, and verifies it shows up in startup context.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, or set Telegram alerts for particular memories.

say_en.text: Help me create a mode for tracking design decisions and client preferences
say_en.note: Claude asks about your work first, then proposes a taxonomy

say_en.text: Add Telegram alerts to my existing mode
say_en.note: You pick the observation types or concept tags that trigger them

say_en.text: Check whether my mode installed and appears in startup context
say_en.note: It restarts the worker and checks startup context
